parameters.name: GroupName
parameters.description: The name of the whitelist group for the instance.

parameters.name: ModifyMode
parameters.description:
The modification mode of the whitelist. Valid values:

- 0: overwrites the whitelist group.
- 1: adds a whitelist group.
- 2: deletes a whitelist group.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the instance resides.

parameters.name: SecurityIPList
parameters.description: The IP addresses in the whitelist group. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,).
